events.prompt: I have a PDF emissions report for 2023. Where can I upload it so it becomes part of this city inventory?
events.body:
Ask Clima

Hello! I'm Clima, your virtual assistant. I'm here to guide you through the process of accurately measuring and reporting your city's greenhouse gas emissions. How can I assist you today?

I have a PDF emissions report for 2023. Where can I upload it so it becomes part of this city inventory?

Open the relevant 2023 city inventory, then go to the inventory’s Data Sources section and choose Add data source / Upload file. Upload the PDF there and assign it to the relevant sector(s) and reporting year.

A PDF report may be retained as supporting evidence, but its emissions values may still need to be entered or mapped into the applicable inventory sectors—especially if the report is not in a structured data format.
